description: Pathology case. Triangle 2 is exactly zero-area in the source (verts 4 and 5 coincide) and must be dropped by both kernels identically -- drop it in one and not the other and every subsequent triangleIndex shifts, which would misalign the whole warp batch. The near-zero scale on handA and the 195 degree rotation drive maxStretch well past the warning threshold. Orientation flipping is covered by case 08.
